definitions.explanation: The distance a vehicle can travel per unit of fuel. Short for {燃料|ねんりょう}{費|ひ} (fuel cost/consumption). Used when discussing how economical a car or other vehicle is to operate.

examples.japanese: この{車|くるま}は{燃費|ねんぴ}がいい。
examples.english: This car has good gas mileage.

examples.japanese: {燃費|ねんぴ}を{気|き}にして{運転|うんてん}している。
examples.english: I drive with fuel efficiency in mind.

examples.japanese: {高速道路|こうそくどうろ}のほうが{一般道|いっぱんどう}より{燃費|ねんぴ}がいいことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Highways tend to give better fuel efficiency than regular roads.

notes:
{燃費|ねんぴ} is an abbreviation of {燃料消費量|ねんりょうしょうひりょう} (fuel consumption) or {燃料費|ねんりょうひ} (fuel cost). In Japan, fuel efficiency is measured in km/L (kilometers per liter).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {燃費|ねんぴ}がいい: good fuel efficiency
- {燃費|ねんぴ}が{悪|わる}い: poor fuel efficiency
- {燃費|ねんぴ}を{抑|おさ}える: to keep fuel costs down
- {低燃費|ていねんぴ}: fuel-efficient (often in ads)
- {実燃費|じつねんぴ}: real-world fuel economy

USAGE:
Very common in car reviews and advertisements. {低燃費|ていねんぴ} is a selling point frequently highlighted for hybrid and electric vehicles.

RELATED WORDS:
- {燃料|ねんりょう}: fuel
- ガソリン: gasoline
- ハイブリッド{車|しゃ}: hybrid car
